text:
Sam: Huge shoutout to @Lee, @Marta and the oncall crew — you stayed late and saved the Dedicated rollout. I dropped dumplings in the kitchen for everyone :dumpling::sparkles: 
Marta: omg thanks Sam! unexpected snacks are the best :heart: 
Lee: caught the routing policy regression just in time. big props to @Devon for the rollback plan. 
Devon: team effort — glad the `rdeploy rollback --to v3.2.1` path worked cleanly. also :mag_right: for alert tweaks. 
Sasha: ops-bot deserves a raise, it paged the right folks at 02:13 :robot_face: :raised_hands: 
ops-bot: Incident 1794012345 — rollback executed, services stable, postmortem scheduled. 
Sam: also massive thanks to @Maria in support for triaging the customer report quickly and summarizing logs. saved a lot of hunting time. 
Maria: happy to help — appreciate the dumplings too :) 
Lee: putting a note on tomorrow's retro to talk follow-ups and make the routing tests stricter. 
Marta: small poll — when should I bring dumplings again? React with :one: for Monday or :two: for Tuesday. 
Sam: :100: whoever took the last soy sauce owes me lunch :joy:
